premise: A knight in his thirties serving a minor lord on the border. Decent with a sword, nothing special.

bible.title: Edge of the Realm
bible.era: High Medieval era: steel swords, chainmail, and horse-drawn travel.

extraordinary.reach: There is no magic or supernatural power in this world.

peoples.name: Humans
peoples.culture: Hardy borderland folk who value loyalty and practical skills over high-born ancestry.

travel.description: Travel is slow and arduous, done on horseback or on foot along poorly maintained dirt roads.

medicine.healing: Basic herbal poultices and stitching. Sickness and deep wounds are highly dangerous.

laws.text: Banditry, raiding, and theft are punishable by hanging.

rules.text: Magic and the supernatural do not exist in this world.
Injuries must heal naturally, and a serious infection is often fatal.
The local lord's word is the sole law on the border.

mysteries.question: Who is leaking patrol routes to the Ironwood Raiders?
mysteries.answer: The stableboy, Will, has been bribed with silver by the raiders to leave messages under a hollow rock by the forest edge.
clues: A map of patrol routes was found slightly misplaced in the stable loft.
Will has suddenly acquired several shiny silver coins he could not have earned honestly.
Muddy bootprints matching the stableboy's boots lead to the hollow rock near the forest boundary.

player.name: Ser Alistair
player.description: A quiet, weathered knight who has spent his prime years on the border. He values practical solutions over chivalric ideals.
player.appearance: Broad-shouldered and rugged, with tired brown eyes, short-trimmed hair showing early grey, wearing clean but visibly repaired chainmail over a dark wool gambeson.

skills.name: Swordplay
skills.notes: Decent with a blade; years of practical skirmishing have taught him how to survive.

skills.name: Horsemanship
skills.notes: Capable of riding in combat and managing his mount.

skills.name: Survival
skills.notes: Familiar with tracking, finding shelter, and enduring the harsh northern borderlands.

traits.name: Weathered
traits.description: Accustomed to long days in the saddle and rough weather; minor discomforts do not bother him.

loves: The quiet of a peaceful evening
fears: A senseless death in an unremembered skirmish

items.name: Iron arming sword
items.description: A reliable, well-balanced sword with a scuffed leather hilt.

items.name: Battered chainmail
items.description: A sturdy suit of chainmail showing signs of repair.

items.name: Heater shield
items.description: A wooden shield bound with iron, painted with the faded crest of House Valer.

items.name: Sturdy bay gelding
items.description: A calm, dependable horse trained for travel and light skirmishes.

connections.name: Lord Robert Valer
connections.note: Your liege lord, whom you have served faithfully for nearly a decade.

backstory.text: You took up service with House Valer ten years ago, seeking steady employment on the frontier.
You have fought in minor skirmishes against cattle rustlers and bandits, earning a reputation as a reliable, if unremarkable, shield-man.

lord-valer.name: Lord Robert Valer
lord-valer.description: An aging, stern lord carrying the weight of a failing house on his shoulders.
lord-valer.appearance: Grey-bearded, lined face, wearing a heavy fur-trimmed cloak over plain iron plate.

wants: Secure his lands from the raiders

ser-tristan.name: Ser Tristan the Bold
ser-tristan.description: A younger, ambitious knight who resents being stationed on the quiet border.
ser-tristan.appearance: Sharp-jawed with slick black hair, wearing polished steel armor that has seen little combat.

fears: Dying in obscurity on the border
wants: A chance to win fame and leave for a wealthier court

house-valer.name: House Valer
house-valer.description: A minor noble house tasked with guarding the kingdom's northernmost border.
house-valer.goal: To secure the border against raiders and keep the King's favor despite their meager resources.
house-valer.methods: Diligent patrols, fortification upkeep, and harsh punishment of lawbreakers.
house-valer.strength: A dozen sworn men-at-arms and two knights.
secrets: Lord Valer is heavily in debt to a merchant guild down south.

border-raiders.name: The Ironwood Raiders
border-raiders.description: A desperate band of outlaws and deserters hiding in the Wild Woods.
border-raiders.goal: To plunder Oakhaven Village and break House Valer's hold on the region.
border-raiders.methods: Ambushes, nighttime raids, and terrorizing isolated farmsteads.
border-raiders.strength: Dozens of desperate fighters armed with hunting bows and rusted axes.
secrets: They have a spy inside Stonecliff Keep.

keep-yard.name: Keep Courtyard
keep-yard.description: A muddy yard enclosed by grey stone walls, smelling of wet hay and horse manure.

stonecliff-keep.name: Stonecliff Keep
stonecliff-keep.description: A modest, drafty stone fort perched on a rocky bluff overlooking the borderlands.

border-village.name: Oakhaven Village
border-village.description: A small cluster of thatched-roof cottages surrounded by palisade walls.

wild-woods.name: The Wild Woods
wild-woods.description: A dense, unmapped forest stretching beyond the kingdom's border, home to outlaws.

fact-1.text: You are a sworn knight in your thirties, serving Lord Valer on the rugged northern border.

fact-2.text: The Ironwood Raiders have grown bolder recently, threatening the local settlements.

fact-3.text: The keep is low on men-at-arms, meaning every patrol is dangerous.

border-skirmishes.title: Defense of the Border
border-skirmishes.stakes: The survival of Oakhaven Village and the security of House Valer's border lands.

An outlying farmstead is burned to the ground.
Raiders launch a full-scale assault on Oakhaven Village.

event-1.title: The Ironwood Raiders gathering: Scouts spot raider activity near Oakhaven Village.

positions: Lord Valer standing by the stable door
Ser Tristan leaning against a post nearby
scene.ended_on: Lord Valer rolls up the damp map and watches you, waiting for your response.

state.summary: You are Alistair, a seasoned border knight in his thirties serving a minor lord at the edge of the realm. As tension rises with local outlaws, you must manage your duties and defend the vulnerable borderlands with little more than your trusty blade.

scenes.narration: Cold drizzle falls over Stonecliff Keep, washing the smell of wet hay and fresh manure through the muddy yard. Lord Robert Valer stands near the wooden stables, a heavy fur-trimmed cloak draped over his iron plate, holding down the corners of a muddy parchment map against the damp wind. Beside him, Ser Tristan the Bold leans against a stable post, his polished steel armor gleaming despite the grey sky, looking thoroughly bored by the frontier mud. As you walk over, the squelch of your boots drawing their attention, Lord Valer looks up from his map. His lined face is grim, the dark circles under his tired eyes telling of a sleepless night. He taps a thick finger on a marked crossing along the forest edge. "Alistair," he says, his voice low and heavy. "The Ironwood Raiders struck a homestead near Oakhaven Village just before dawn. My scouts say they took three horses and the winter grain. We have barely enough men to man the wall, but we cannot let this pass without a response. I need a steady head out there."

choices: Accept the mission to track the raiders near Oakhaven Village.
Suggest Ser Tristan lead the patrol instead to win his glory.
Ask Lord Valer for extra scouts before leaving the keep.
